Data.purpose: Préparer un provider de stockage personnel ou partagé sur Google Drive sans rendre Google obligatoire pour le framework.

shared_folder.authorization: existing Drive permissions plus app authorization

security_rules: Never embed client secrets, refresh tokens or service-account credentials in a public site.
Public pages remain empty of private Drive data until authorization succeeds.
Drive permissions determine access to shared/user data.
Do not copy private Drive content into generated public site artifacts.
Disconnect clears in-memory authorization state and provider caches.
notes: The provider adapter is optional; the framework remains fully usable without a Google account.
appDataFolder is appropriate for application configuration that users do not need to manipulate directly.
Visible personal folders are preferable for user-managed documents and binaries.

dictionnaire_donnees.note: Adapter Google Drive préparé, non activé par défaut.
